title: Tablets Guide: Types, Uses, Towers and Map Planning
summary: Precursor Tablets juice the maps around a Waystone with extra content and rewards. This guide covers the tablet types, how many you can slot, what 'uses remaining' means, and how to plan Towers and overlapping tablets for SSF versus trade.
description: A source-linked reference for Precursor Tablets in Path of Exile 2: types, slot rules tied to Waystone modifiers, use limits, and map-planning strategy.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Precursor Tablet currency item icon from Path of Exile 2 - an archaic tablet that adds league content and rewards to surrounding Atlas maps

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.callout: Slot Precursor Tablets alongside a Waystone before you Traverse. Each Tablet adds its implicit content (Breach, Delirium, Expedition, Ritual, Irradiated, or Overseer) to the maps around that node. A Tablet is consumed per Waystone use, so a failed map still spends that use.
calloutDetail: Slot count is set by the Waystone's modifier count: 0-2 mods = 1 slot, 3-5 = 2, 6+ = 3.
Tablets are Magic-only (one Prefix + one Suffix) and cannot be upgraded to Rare.

answers.label: Plan first
text: Pick the mechanic you want to farm, then overlap Towers so their tablets stack.

answers.label: SSF progress
text: Irradiated / generic Precursor Tablets raise area level and rewards with less risk.

answers.label: Avoid
text: Slotting a Tablet on a map you cannot finish - the use is wasted.

facts.label: Where
note: Since 0.3.1 Tablets slot with the Waystone, not the Tower.

facts.label: Slots
note: More Waystone modifiers = more Tablet slots.

facts.label: Rarity
note: One Prefix + one Suffix; cannot become Rare.

facts.label: Uses
note: Failed map still consumes the use.

sections.title: Tablet types
intro: Every Precursor Tablet shares the same Prefix pool but a different implicit that adds a specific endgame encounter to the maps in range.

members.title: Breach Precursor Tablet
body: 12-18 maps in range contain Breaches. Suffixes boost Magic/Rare monsters inside Breaches.

members.title: Delirium Precursor Tablet
body: 12-18 maps contain Mirrors of Delirium. Suffixes improve their reward tier.

members.title: Expedition Precursor Tablet
body: 12-18 maps contain Expedition encounters. Suffixes raise Artifact quantity.

members.title: Ritual Precursor Tablet
body: 12-18 maps contain Ritual Altars. Suffixes improve Ritual loot.

members.title: Precursor (Irradiated) Tablet
body: 12-18 maps are Irradiated (+1 Area Level). Safe, broad progression boost.

members.title: Overseer Precursor Tablet
body: 2-4 maps contain Bosses, with Suffixes adding Strongboxes, Shrines and Essences.

sections.title: What a Tablet can be applied to
note: Tablets slot alongside a Waystone you are about to run. They affect the maps in range of that node, not the Tower itself (Towers only reveal and drop a Tablet).

sections.title: How to get Tablets
intro: Tablets drop from map content and complete Towers; specific tablets favour their own mechanic.

routes.label: Completing Towers
body: Every Tower you clear guarantees one Precursor Tablet drop.

routes.label: Mechanic drops
body: A Breach Tablet is more likely from Breach content, Ritual Tablet from Rituals, and so on.

routes.label: Distilled Despair on Waystones
body: Adding the '+X% Precursor Tablets found' modifier to a Waystone raises tablet drops.

routes.label: Trade / Currency Exchange
body: Buy specific tablets from other players in trade leagues.

steps.label: Choose the node
body: Pick a Waystone node whose surrounding maps you want to juice.

steps.label: Slot Tablet(s)
body: Place up to the slot limit (set by Waystone modifiers) alongside the Waystone.

steps.label: Traverse
body: Run the map; each Tablet spends one use and its implicit applies to the range.

items.label: Map is completable
checks: You can finish the map so the Tablet use is not wasted.
items.why: A failed map still consumes the Tablet use.
items.fix: Use the Tablet on a map you can clear.

items.label: Enough Waystone mods
checks: Confirm the Waystone has the modifier count for the slots you need.
items.why: Too few mods = fewer Tablet slots.
items.fix: Add modifiers to the Waystone first.

items.label: Overlap planned
checks: Towers near each other so their tablet ranges stack.

rows.benefit: Irradiated tablets raise area level safely
rows.recommendation: Use generic Irradiated tablets for steady progress

rows.benefit: Stack one mechanic's tablets for max density
rows.recommendation: Overlap Towers of the same mechanic

rows.scenario: Tablet on a map you die in
rows.loss: That Tablet use is spent with no reward
rows.recommendation: Only slot Tablets on maps you can clear.
Add mods if you need 2-3 tablets.

sections.title: Use, sell or hold
marketNote: Tablet prices vary by league and mechanic demand; re-check in-game before trading.

use.condition: You are mapping the area the Tablet affects
use.first: Slot it on a Waystone you will clear
text: Best when the Tablet's mechanic is your current farm target.

sell.condition: You do not run that mechanic
sell.first: List on trade at current rate
text: Mechanic tablets you skip are easy currency.
Hold if your route reaches that content soon.

entries.question: Why did my Tablet 'disappear' after a failed map?
summary: A player failed a map and the slotted Tablet was gone.
editorialAnalysis: The Tablet spends one use each time the Waystone is used; a failed map still consumes that use.
officialAnswer: Only slot Tablets on maps you can complete.

entries.question: Do I put Tablets on the Tower or the Waystone?
editorialAnalysis: Since 0.3.1 Tablets slot alongside the Waystone; Towers only reveal the area and drop one Tablet.
officialAnswer: Slot Tablets with the Waystone you are about to run.
